document.title: Aurora Retreat
document.summary: Immersive wellness booking platform blending AI concierge, personalized retreats, and atmospheric storytelling.

body.raw:
import { Steps, Callout } from "@/components/mdx/mdx-components"; ## Product pillars Crafted hero scenes with Three.js atmospheric shaders and WebGL reflections to match each destination's mood. Built ML-driven itinerary generator using OpenAI embeddings and fine-tuned prompts trained on concierge transcripts. Architected role-aware GraphQL gateway with automated vendor onboarding and ledger reconciliation. ## Highlights - Advanced accessibility audits (WCAG 2.2 AA) with keyboard-friendly 3D scenes and reduced motion fallbacks. - Real-time analytics dashboard with Grafana and event streaming from Apache Pulsar for supply-demand balancing. - Integrated revenue share tracking with Stripe Connect, automated payouts, and compliance reporting.

Aurora Retreat closed a Series A with the product demo as centerpiece, credited for surfacing our north-star narrative.

document.title: Block Crust Adventure
document.summary: A tactile Flutter arcade that fuses voxel worlds with haptic puzzles, shipped to iOS, Android, and web in one codebase.
outcomes: Top 5 launch on Google Play Indie corner

body.raw:
import { Gallery } from "@/components/mdx/mdx-components";

## Gameplay loops

- Built responsive voxel renderer with custom shaders, 120hz animation loops, and battery-aware performance budgets.
- Designed puzzle difficulty curves using telemetry-driven scoring and ML-based hint generation.
- Implemented cross-device save slots with Firebase listeners and offline-first persistence.

## Motion & polish

<Gallery images={[
  { src: "/images/projects/block-crust-battle.webp", alt: "Boss battle animation" },
  { src: "/images/projects/block-crust-builder.webp", alt: "Level builder UI" }
]} />

- Authored cinematic haptics with Core Haptics + custom Android vibration patterns.
- Composed 150+ micro-interactions with Rive state machines and spring physics.
- Added tactile audio cues with procedural synthesis for accessible gameplay.

document.title: CurC Health Companion
document.summary: A cross-platform health concierge that fuses Flutter, Firebase, and Gemini AI to personalize care plans for chronic patients.

body.raw:
import { Callout, Gallery } from "@/components/mdx/mdx-components";

## Overview

CurC pairs a medical-grade wearable with a conversational copilot that adapts to each patient's health goals. I designed the experience, architected the stack, and led a hybrid web + mobile release across three countries.

## Highlights

<Callout type="success" title="Signals">
Prototype-to-production in 10 weeks with real-time vitals, personalized nudges, and clinical escalation flows.
</Callout>

- Architected a Flutter app with offline-first caches, realtime Firestore sync, and deep link automations.
- Built Gemini AI prompts that translate sensor streams into natural-language coaching and doctor-ready reports.
- Orchestrated HIPAA compliance with encrypted storage, audit logging, and zero-trust role policies.

## Experience Design

<Gallery images={[
  { src: "/images/projects/curc-dashboard.webp", alt: "CurC dashboard" },
  { src: "/images/projects/curc-mobile.webp", alt: "CurC mobile coaching" }
]} />

I crafted a dual-surface design language: cinematic gradients for patient motivation, monospace overlays for clinical clarity, and motion patterns tuned to 200ms springs.

## Outcomes

- Reduced manual triage time by 41% through Gemini-authored intake summaries.
- 92 NPS from beta cohort with inclusive typography and calibrated accessibility states.
- Integrated with hospital EMR via secure FHIR adapters maintained in a shared monorepo.

import { Callout, Steps } from "@/components/mdx/mdx-components"; ## The brief Turn a static Wordpress site into a high-trust civic engagement OS with powerful storytelling, moderation tooling, and analytics. ## Architecture
Design system refactor

Authored a cohesive shadcn/ui-driven design system with AA+ contrast, semantic tokens, and automated docs in MDX.

Edge-ready API

Built edge API routes backed by PlanetScale + Drizzle ORM with row-level security for student privacy.

Moderation workflows

Created command center dashboards with review queues, toxicity scoring, and AI-generated summaries.

 ## Launch impact Handled a 28k RPM surge with graceful degradation, proactive caching, and Slack alerting pipelines. - Introduced motion primitives for card hover, parallax banners, and sticky legislative trackers. - Optimized LCP to 1.1s on 3G via partial hydration and granular image streaming.
